description: Backend-neutral type descriptor tests — verifies that IR dump produces spec-format RuntimeTypeDescriptor strings for all DEAL types.

tests.name: primitive-null
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: null = null; return; }

tests.name: primitive-boolean
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: boolean = true; return; }

tests.name: primitive-int
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: int = 42; return; }

tests.name: primitive-number
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: number = 3.14; return; }

tests.name: primitive-string
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: string = "hello"; return; }

tests.name: primitive-table
tests.source: function f(): null { let t: table = {}; return; }

tests.name: array-int-spec-format
tests.source: function f(): null { let a: int[] = [1, 2, 3]; return; }

tests.name: array-string-spec-format
tests.source: function f(): null { let a: string[] = ["a", "b"]; return; }

tests.name: nested-array-spec-format
tests.source: function f(): null { let a: int[][] = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]; return; }

tests.name: nullable-int-spec-format
tests.source: function f(): null { let n: int | null = null; return; }

tests.name: nullable-string-spec-format
tests.source: function f(): null { let n: string | null = null; return; }

tests.name: class-descriptor-spec-format
tests.source:
class User { name: string = ""; }
function f(): null { let u: User = { name: "Ada" }; return; }

tests.name: nullable-class-descriptor
tests.source:
class User { name: string = ""; }
function f(): null { let u: User | null = null; return; }

tests.name: function-type-descriptor
tests.source: function add(a: int, b: int): int { return a + b; }

tests.name: function-type-mixed-params
tests.source: function check(x: int, s: string): boolean { return true; }

tests.name: function-type-nullable-return
tests.source: function maybe(x: int): int | null { if (x === 0) { return null; } return x; }

tests.name: function-type-array-param
tests.source: function sum(xs: int[]): int { return xs[0]; }
